name: Eleanor Waverley
source:
Eleanor Waverley is the eldest child of the Waverley children. She is also one of Your Character's love interests. She is first seen in Chapter 2.

Eleanor is mature and responsible, as she is in charge of taking care of her younger siblings. She is very formal and polite with her siblings viewing her as a mother figure. She is also shown to be kind, given that she allows Your Character to stay at the manor. Eleanor has difficulty telling others hurtful things, begging Your Character not to reveal to her siblings that they are ghosts.

Eleanor is shown to be easily flustered if the player chooses to pursue a romance with her. Making the right dialog choices causes Eleanor to stutter and blush easily while improving the relationship between Eleanor and Your Character.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Eleanor_Waverley]Wiki[/url]]
